verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation platform, so self-hosting it under an open-source license is a fair question. The evidence shows only the runtimes and rendering layer are open source; nothing indicates the editor or design platform can be self-hosted or is openly licensed. Community commenters describe the editor as a paid product that is separate from the open-sourced player, which counts only as an adjacent component, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host the full design platform on my own infrastructure under an open-source license
